name: Maintained normally-open pushbutton
summary: A maintained NO pushbutton stays in its actuated condition until the documented return operation.
description: A maintained NO pushbutton stays in its actuated condition until the documented return operation. The control sequence must account for the retained input rather than assuming a momentary pulse.
readingNotes: Identify the release method and any reset interlock.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A maintained pushbutton is different from a spring-return momentary operator.
